title: Flat 64-bit 5-window Eisenstein stored-leaf birthday search on secp256k1 with explicit scalar services

claims.statement: For uniform unrestricted production secp256k1 ECDLP challenges and fresh algorithm coins, the grouped stored-leaf search in proof.md has success probability at least 0.39 and an upper bound 123.149554427177781 on log2(total expected classical computation in the fixed C=1000 scalar AArch64 instruction normalization). All preprocessing, failed paths, arithmetic, address/control work, transfers, verification and output are included across processors. Peak reserved memory is below 2^138 bytes; there is no free advice or future-target amortization. The estimate uses an explicitly disclosed uniform 64-bit flat analytical address space per processor (under COST_MODEL.md's scalar 64-bit instruction basis, matching the disclosed convention of submission 4e2d5241) with five-window (52,51,51,51,51) BT/P1/E/G tables and five-window (45,45,45,44,44) F/fwd tables at NODES=2^58, explicit TBZ block ends (zero VMSAv9 stage-1 permission faults), a 128-bit cumulative fixup meter (DELTA_F=2^71) integrated in ytransport.s:ychunk, and the explicit scalar memory-fabric services (MSG=256, GEN_MUL=2^20), denominator-cleared selected-X fiber bound (selected-x.md), self-contained five-window Lemmas E/F/M/K/R/V and pointwise joint-label derivation (success.md Section 7), and global pair-inverse exclusion. The finite experiment establishes only its stated exact-rational certificate, instruction-form, finite simulated EC label, routing-flush, production-driver, meter, bit-extraction, map, and negative-control checks, not production execution, RTL synthesis, or a production collision law.

experiments.purpose: Run exact certificate plus independent schedule/logarithm/gate/memory/cost/fiber checks, finite GF1024 and selected-X algebra, 144 exact EC leaves, production archive and forwarding boundaries, scalar kernel counts, and listed negative controls. Simulate the table builders across classes and compare actual per-row counts with the charged bounds. The wrapper restores nine hashed runtime sources and tests four codec failures. Optional source returns one restored source file without running the suite.
